title: Analysis reproduction for Claim 2 (2.3x median underreport, n=17)
notes: Covers reproducing the ANALYSIS only: recomputing the median and IQR of actual/reported compute ratios from the 17-row calibration table (schema documented in repro/analysis.py; JSON result on stdout; expected median ~= 2.3, IQR ~= [1.4, 4.1]). The calibration table is not yet published as a standalone dataset -- see the paper's open question 'Calibration record as common pool'. Replicating the claim AFRESH means redoing 17 end-to-end replications of audited ML papers: thousands of A100-equivalent GPU-hours and weeks of wall-clock, i.e. the single most expensive artefact behind this paper -- and per this very claim, expect any self-reported figure for it to be optimistic by ~2.3x. The environment digest is left null rather than fabricated; pin it when the data ships.
